correctness.rationale: The exact disconnected-triple list determines the dual as the edge-deleted join union one surviving edge. The join decomposition D=A∪B with intersection I has simply connected, 2-acyclic pieces; H3(I)→H3(A)⊕H3(B) is integrally injective because inclusions of graph cycle lattices are injective. Mayer--Vietoris and Whitehead give D a wedge of R(a,b) three-spheres, and adding uv gives a circle. Integral Alexander duality determines the cut homology without torsion ambiguity. Direct enumeration and two-prime chain checks pass for six parameters; they supplement but are not substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The one-edge defect is an intrinsic and first nontrivial boundary of a classical cut-complex family; its exact topology is not a substitution in intact-biclique formulas. The result shows a new integral top-degree class and loss of \((a-2)(b-2)\) lower-degree classes, with complete two-parameter dual homotopy classification and consequent nonshellability outside a single endpoint. This identifies a structural edge sensitivity that matters to further local-modification studies.
